notes.title: Update notes ver. 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h3]Added "Heart Challenge"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895838/c68a0081395c6f782ee26b91fb1427ac6292b0ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895838/d011479669ebc66632aa09745101f46f54e22fb1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a challenge mode themed after Heart-cut gemstones.
[*] By clearing the tenth type of gemstone with a B rank or higher from the start of the game, you can unlock the "Heart Challenge."
[*] In the Heart Challenge, you'll face challenges related to 12 types of gems, and the total number of trophies will be recorded as your score.
[*] High scores will be recorded for each gemstone, and you can retry at any time of your choosing.
[*] Gems created will be added to the collection just like in the normal mode.
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now delete only the records of the "Birthstone Challenge" and "Heart Challenge."
[*] Fine-tuned the shapes of some gems.
[*] Fine-tuned some parts of the UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix patch notes ver. 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements to Controls/Display[/h3]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update notes ver. 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h3]Added "Birthstone Challenge"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895838/4efed547f3849101d56d73bac8c415e7c99bb516.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a challenge mode themed after 12 types of birthstones.
[*] By clearing the tenth type of gemstone with a B rank or higher from the start of the game, you can unlock the "Birthstone Challenge."
[*] In the Birthstone Challenge, you'll face challenges related to 12 types of gems, and the total number of trophies will be recorded as your score.
[*] High scores will be recorded for each birthstone, and you can retry at any time of your choosing.
[*] Gems created will be added to the collection just like in the normal mode.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements to Controls/Display[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895838/2c91b965a8c1ea9e3df50b2e987e1163eef28ed9.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a feature to adjust the thickness of the guide that indicates the ordered gemstone.
[*] Added a feature to select one of 17 types of art panels and decorate a brick wall with it.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuned the shapes of some gems.
[*] Improved System Stability.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes ver. 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements to Controls/Display[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895838/989dd9c4057c8a2ccef5e696d15c9d9664ff4ae5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a color change feature for the guide that shows the order of the gems.
[*] Fixed an issue where operations outside the window were still active during window display.
[/list]
[h3]Collection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895838/e187ea21f6d499219341b967184561dc920a714a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a feature that enables the display of ratings, names, and other details when viewing each gem individually.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuned the shapes of some gems.
[*] Improved System Stability.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes ver. 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Game Rules[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added SS Rank for shape evaluation.
[*] Shapes with a compatibility rate of 99.00% ([strike]99.90%[/strike]) or higher will be evaluated as SS Rank.
[*] Added SSS Rank for overall evaluation.
[*] An evaluation will be considered SSS Rank if it simultaneously meets the SS Rank for shape and S Rank for color.
[/list]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 3 types of achievements that accommodate the addition of game rules.
[/list]
[h3]Game Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the evaluation criteria for jewels from C Rank to F Rank.
[/list]
[h3]Title[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a feature to hide the UI.
[*] Added a feature to redraw the displayed jewels.
[*] Notes:This button is displayed only when there are 13 or more jewels in the collection.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added inertia when rotating jewels in the collection and evaluation screens.
[*] Minor display adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix patch notes ver. 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3]Game Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] The order content for gems now more likely includes cutting styles that have not yet been created.
[*] Additionally, higher difficulty cutting styles will also appear at an earlier stage more frequently.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements to Controls/Display[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing the Ctrl key simultaneously now allows for rotation, descent, and polishing speed to be reduced to 0.5 times.
[*] The L key now enables the ON/OFF toggle for the guide display of ordered gems.
[*] Minor adjustments have been made to the control guide (there are no changes to the control methods).
[/list]
